 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 CrPC seeking quashing of FIR No.
289/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC registered at Police Station Pandav Nagar.
2. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioner submits that the respondent no.2/complainant had entered appearance through her counsel Mr. Siddharth Chaudhary.

However, thereafter there has been no appearance on behalf of the respondent no.2.
3.
Let fresh notice be issued to the respondent no.2 by all permissible
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/11/2025 at 22:33:22 modes.

4. Let respondent no.2 be served additionally through the IO concerned.
5. Re-notify on 09.02.2026.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J NOVEMBER 4, 2025 N.S. ASWAL
This is a digitally signed order.
